title: Charcoal rules and general penalty
rule: The Chief Executive issues guidelines for efficient charcoal production. Charcoal, other than briquettes, cannot be exported without the Minister's permit.
points: Producing charcoal against the guidelines is an offence.
Exporting charcoal without a permit is an offence.
Anything else with no specific penalty carries the general penalty.
penalty: Charcoal production in breach: fine of TSh 1,000,000 to 3,000,000, or 6 months to 1 year, or both. Charcoal export without a permit: fine of TSh 5,000,000 to 10,000,000, or 1 to 5 years, plus confiscation. General penalty: fine of TSh 500,000, or 6 months, or both.
flag: The general penalty (6 months) differs from Regulations 2004 reg 58 (2 years).
